service_name_cross_check.claim: docker compose exec -T ingestor / -T worker in the new confirmation step match the actual compose service names
service_name_cross_check.evidence: grep '^  [a-z-]*:' deploy/production/docker-compose.yml -> api, worker, ingestor, discord-bot, grading-cron, loki, grafana, caddy -- 'ingestor' and 'worker' confirmed present and spelled exactly as used.

canary_vs_production_scope_decision.claim: the new container-value confirmation (ingestor/worker/enabled-targets) is added ONLY to the production stage's confirm step, not canary's
canary_vs_production_scope_decision.reason: canary's 'Release API canary' step runs `docker compose up -d --no-deps api` -- only the api service, never ingestor/worker/discord-bot. Asserting against containers that don't exist yet in canary would either always fail or require conditionally skipping the assertion, neither of which proves anything. Only 'Promote all production containers' (`docker compose up -d --remove-orphans`, all services) actually starts ingestor/worker, so that is the only stage where inspecting them is meaningful.
canary_vs_production_scope_decision.canary_scope_unchanged: canary's confirm step still checks only SYNDICATE_MACHINE_ENABLED via the api container, exactly as before this lane.

active_mode_regression_check.claim: active-mode deploy behavior for all four vars is unchanged by this lane
active_mode_regression_check.evidence: case-statement active branch sets _ingestor_autorun=true / _ingestor_scheduling_enabled=true / _worker_autorun=true (identical to the previous unconditional literals); _enabled_targets falls back to best-bets when unset in the non-parked branch (identical to the previous ${_enabled_targets:-best-bets} default) -- verified by the unmutated auditParkedModeDeployWorkflow() passing with zero violations against the real, corrected deploy.yml source (test 1 of 10).
